result.rationale: Verified from the diff: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` in groups_controller#members has no upper bound, so any authorized visitor can request an unbounded member list, causing large DB reads and JSON serialization. The diff does introduce this client-controlled limit (previously non-automatic groups returned all members). It is a genuine resource-exhaustion/hardening concern for a new pagination surface, though not a clear correctness defect, so it fits important_non_bug: a specific, material review point grounded in cited diff code (a maintainer would plausibly add a max cap, e.g. 100)

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb line 22: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` - the limit parameter is taken directly from user input with only a default fallback, but no maximum cap. An attacker could pass limit=1000000 to force the server to load and serialize an arbitrarily large number of users, causing performance issues. This is a security/DoS vulnerability introduced by this change.
